scope: Replay of the same 1200 previously reported test examples; not a fresh held-out test.
aggregation_note: Task rows are micro-averaged. English averages are unweighted means of four task metrics. Overall rows pool all counts; these are different summaries.

metric_definitions.masking_unit: unioned label-agnostic character coverage, merging overlapping/adjacent spans
metric_definitions.strict_unit: exact start character, end character and label

phases.online: Irreversible commitments made while updates arrive, without explicit close.
phases.explicit_close: Includes pending entities released at the explicit end-of-message signal; not live output.
phases.full_text: Previously saved cold full-sentence snapshot at threshold 0.5; no commitment policy.
phases.final_snapshot: Previously saved final incremental-model snapshot at threshold 0.5; may revise earlier candidates.

provenance.note: Historical producer and diagnostic consumer differ. Full original same-commit gate remains unpassed. Only aggregate data are published.
